title: Development and implementation of innovative, digital information and training concepts for children and adolescents with gender incongruence/gender dysphoria (GI/GD) and their families
summary: Children and adolescents with gender incongruence (GI) and the associated psychological distress (gender dysphoria; GD) often wait a long time for an appointment at a specialist consultation. In order to use the initial consultation in a more efficient and personalized manner, families are given access to a digital information platform and an online training with experts during the waiting time. This may improve families‘ informedness and confidence in decision-making options for coping with GI/GD prior to the initial consultation. This should reduce the length of initial consultations and shorten waiting times in the long term.

interventions.name: After the regular waiting period, the families in the comparison group present themselves at the study site for an initial specialist consultation about GI/GD. They do not receive any intervention as defined by the study.

The intervention consists of access to a digital information platform and online training on GI/GD before the initial consultation. After the intervention, families present at the study site for an earlier but shorter initial consultation.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
registration for an initial consultation at a study center
Exclusion criteria:
insufficient knowledge of German
